title: panax japonicus f. dolichocarpus
intro: Panax japonicus f. dolichocarpus, commonly known as Japanese ginseng, is a variety of the Panax japonicus plant, which is a type of ginseng native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties that may help to improve overall well-being and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Japanese ginseng include stimulating the immune system, improving cognitive function, and enhancing physical performance. Bioactive constituents of Japanese ginseng include ginsenosides, such as Rg1, Rb1, and Rg3, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
